description: This file defines configuration options and a validator for Azure Table Storage within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes the AzureTableStorageOptions class with properties to set table name, delete state behavior, data format, and lifecycle initialization stage, as well as a validator class for these options.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for AzureTableStorage, including table name, data formatting, state deletion, and initialization stage.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for AzureTableStorageOptions, ensuring the correctness of configuration settings.

methods.description: Constructor for the validator, passing options and name to the base class.
